hard_gates.gate: G1 tenant isolation (critic's own attack: API, import, tenant export, jobs, database role)
hard_gates.evidence: api/attack-s24.mjs and api/attack-s24-out.txt. Tenant B (gulfsteel) made canary text, number and select fields and a contact. As tenant A I sent 26 requests, each with and without X-Tenant/X-Tenant-Id headers: get, put, list and search of B's field; B's contact (get, put, history); filter, sort and group by B's keys; CSV and XLSX exports with B's columns; the list definition; OpenAPI; the audit log; search; the import fields and template. Every answer was 404, 400, or 200 with no canary, no B id and no B value. When two fields have the same key, A's filter, sort, group and export show no B value. On import, a column named custom.<B key> or with B's label is left unmapped, and mapping it by hand is refused (400). A lookup pointing at B's contact is refused (400). B cannot read or download A's tenant export (404). Database probe as erp_app with tenant A bound (api/db-role-probe.txt): 0 of B's definitions or values visible, value_text on a real B field and record returns null (the B control reads 'distributor'), UPDATE and DELETE of B rows touch 0 rows, and an INSERT of a B row is refused by RLS. RLS is enabled and forced on definitions and field_values, and no customfields function is SECURITY DEFINER.
viewer@alnoor: reads fields, record types and lists with custom sort (200). Field create and update: 403. Import fields: 403. noaccess@alnoor: 403 on all 8 requests (attack-s24-out.txt).

G2PermissionTests.Every_endpoint_under_a_reviewed_prefix_declares_exactly_its_reviewed_permission caught it ('declares customfields.fields.manage but is not in the reviewed map').

biggest_gap.title: The audit trail shows a custom field's stored values, not their meaning: option keys instead of labels (English keys on the Arabic screen) and dates as yyyy-mm-dd
biggest_gap.detail: p09's own surface does its job. It beats Odoo on add-a-field-and-filter on every metric, holds every isolation and permission attack, and its gates caught both plants. Custom fields now also flow through import. But the audit trail, which the spec lists as a place where every new field must appear, still reads like a database dump, unchanged from the earlier round 3 critic's finding. When a single-select value changes, the record's change line and its History panel show the option key: 'Customer segment: from wholesale to government', and on the Arabic screen 'شريحة العميل: من wholesale إلى government' and 'شروط التسليم 55484: FOB → EXW'. They should show the option labels: 'جملة → حكومي' and 'فوب → تسليم المصنع' in Arabic, 'Wholesale → Government' in English. A custom date shows as '2027-12-31' in history, while the form and lists show 31/12/2027. Lookups and numbers are already shown properly (250,000.75). An Arabic-speaking UAE accountant reading who changed a customer's segment sees English codes, and Odoo's tracking shows the selection labels. The fix: render select values through the field's option labels in the caller's language (history_change or the history API), and dates in the locale format, as the list already does. Note for the lead: this round is BLOCKED by something else. Neither clean-clone verify passed, because the e2e ours-driver health check of p14's import-5000 task was invalid in both runs (see other_findings). That is not p09's code.

other_findings: [route: p14-import-export] The clean-clone verify fails reproducibly on the ours-driver health check of import-5000: 'invalid: action outside the clock (set-up): the page changed what it shows without a counted step causing it (1 change ... StyleRecalcInvalidationTracking ... after a page task no step caused: a DevTools command of the harness during step 2)'. It failed in both of my runs (0.304 s and 0.266 s into the measured part), at a load peak of 25.9 and 27.4 in that window; every other check passed. The driver or the import page needs to stop that uncounted screen change. If the cause is the instrument judging its own DevTools read, it also concerns p01-odoo-rig, which is frozen (the class of gate backlog row 8, though this task is not listed there). Evidence: verify-run1/ and verify-run2/import-5000-*.json.

[route: p14-import-export] The full tenant export crashes in the demo's worker. POST /api/importexport/tenant-exports gives 202, then the job fails with jobs.unexpected: System.UnauthorizedAccessException: Access to the path '/app/attachments-data' is denied, at LocalAttachmentStore..ctor called from TenantExportJobHandler.RunAsync line 51. The export record stays 'queued' and is never marked failed. The seeded 'succeeded' export holds only README.txt (30 bytes). So custom fields in the full export could not be judged. Evidence: api/attack-s24-out.txt and api/exstat.mjs.

[route: p18-visual-design] The kernel DateInput (web/src/kernel/forms/dateInput.tsx, p18's 51c9e9ff) mangles a date typed with its own separators. '15/06/2027' becomes '15//06/202', because the auto-slash is added and then the typed slash too, and maxLength cuts the year. yyyy-mm-dd typing is mangled the same way. Then the save is refused with 'Enter a date as year-month-day (2026-12-31)', which contradicts the dd/mm/yyyy placeholder. Only 8 bare digits work. On p09's surface this hits every custom date value and a date field's 'Default for new records' ('The default does not fit the kind of field'). Evidence: ui/s24-en-typed-date-with-slashes.jpg, ui/scripts/s2.mjs and s11.mjs.

p09: adding a required field that has a default still blocks saving any existing record from its form. Ctrl+S on an unchanged old contact gives 'This field is required.' on Credit cap (default 1500.25), because the form sends null while the API applies the default when the key is absent. With 100,008 contacts, every old contact must have the field typed in before its first edit (ui/s24-en-required-default-blocks-old-record.jpg; ui/scripts/s5.mjs). This is unchanged since the earlier round 3 critic.
